Graduating from medical school

Receiving my MD diploma at the Central Asian University Medical School graduation ceremony.

On July 4, 2025 I received my MD diploma at the Central Asian University Medical School graduation ceremony. The diploma was presented by Tashkent City Hokim Jahongir Artikhodjayev. It marked the end of six years of medical school, from 2019 to 2025.
